hooks.command: d='C:/Users/david/.claude/task-observer/skill-observations'; n=$(find "$d/observation-log" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.md' -exec grep -l '^status: open$' {} + 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); last=$(cat "$d/last-review-date.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo never); msg='Invoke the task-observer skill and run its Session Start Protocol before the first tool call.'; if [ "$n" -gt 0 ]; then msg="$msg $n open observations; last review: $last."; case "$last" in never) msg="$msg Offer the review." ;; esac; fi; printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"%s"}}\n' "$msg"

CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+push.*(\bmain\b|\bmaster\b)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: pushing to main/master requires explicit human approval' >&2; exit 2; fi
